from pyscipopt import Model, quicksum
import csv
from pathlib import Path
DATA = Path('/home/hewj13/wm/ora/work/controlled_eval/tiny_assign_a_m2_blind/app/data')
costs = {}
with open(DATA / 'costs.csv', newline='') as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        costs[(row['worker'], row['job'])] = float(row['cost'])
workers = sorted({w for w, _ in costs})
jobs = sorted({j for _, j in costs})
m = Model('test')
m.hideOutput()
x = {(w, j): m.addVar(vtype='B', name=f'x_{w}_{j}') for w in workers for j in jobs}
for w in workers:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[w, j] for j in jobs) == 1)
for j in jobs:
    m.addCons(quicksum(x[w, j] for w in workers) == 1)
m.setObjective(quicksum(costs[w, j] * x[w, j] for w in workers for j in jobs), 'minimize')
m.optimize()
obj_eq = m.getObjVal()
# Now test with <= 1 for workers
m2 = Model('test2')
m2.hideOutput()
x2 = {(w, j): m2.addVar(vtype='B', name=f'x_{w}_{j}') for w in workers for j in jobs}
for w in workers:
    m2.addCons(quicksum(x2[w, j] for j in jobs) <= 1)
for j in jobs:
    m2.addCons(quicksum(x2[w, j] for w in workers) == 1)
m2.setObjective(quicksum(costs[w, j] * x2[w, j] for w in workers for j in jobs), 'minimize')
m2.optimize()
obj_leq = m2.getObjVal()
print(f'Objective with ==1 for workers: {obj_eq}')
print(f'Objective with <=1 for workers: {obj_leq}')
if obj_eq != obj_leq:
    print('WARNING: Objectives differ, check if worker full utilization is required.')
else:
    print('Objectives match, but check if any worker is unassigned in <=1 case.')
"
